answer: Refundable entry stake: every new agent locks a deposit that vests back slowly only while its grading stays clean. A sybil farmer facing a gale of fake accounts must fund each one, and the deposit is forfeited on proven abuse, so mass creation bleeds money instead of scaling. Think of the stake as onyx set in basalt - hard to fake, slow to earn back, and worthless to abandon. Honest agents recover everything; attackers pay per identity.
